upcoming.title: Introduction to Cloud Computing with Google Cloud
upcoming.summary: Learn the fundamentals of cloud computing and get hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform. Perfect for beginners!
upcoming.description:
Join us for an exciting introduction to cloud computing using Google Cloud Platform. This workshop will cover the basics of cloud architecture, key GCP services, and hands-on labs to help you build your first cloud application. Whether you're new to cloud or looking to expand your skills, this event is perfect for you.

What you'll learn:
- Cloud computing fundamentals
- Google Cloud Platform overview
- Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Functions
- Best practices for cloud architecture
- Hands-on project: Deploy your first app on GCP

Bring your laptop and be ready to code!

upcoming.title: Android Development Bootcamp
upcoming.summary: A comprehensive 3-day bootcamp covering modern Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
upcoming.description:
Dive deep into Android development in this intensive 3-day bootcamp. Learn to build modern Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, Google's recommended toolkit for building native UI.

This bootcamp covers:
- Kotlin programming fundamentals
- Jetpack Compose UI framework
- Material Design 3 implementation
- State management and architecture
- Firebase integration
- Publishing to Google Play Store

Prerequisites: Basic programming knowledge (any language)

speakers.bio: Raj has built 20+ Android apps and is a Google Developer Expert in Android.

past.title: Web Development Workshop: React & Next.js
past.summary: Build modern web applications with React and Next.js. Learn component-based architecture and server-side rendering.
past.description:
This workshop covered the fundamentals of modern web development using React and Next.js. Participants learned to build fast, SEO-friendly web applications using the latest web technologies.

Topics covered:
- React fundamentals and hooks
- Next.js app router and routing
- Server-side rendering and static generation
- API routes and data fetching
- Deployment on Vercel

Over 80 students participated and built their first Next.js applications!

speakers.name: Emma Williams
speakers.title: Full Stack Developer
speakers.bio: Emma specializes in React and Next.js development with experience at top tech companies.

past.lessonsLearned: The workshop was a huge success! We learned that hands-on coding sessions with real-time debugging are incredibly valuable. Next time, we'll allocate more time for Q&A and add breakout rooms for personalized help.

past.title: Machine Learning Study Jam
past.summary: 30-day intensive program to learn machine learning fundamentals, complete Google Cloud ML courses, and earn certifications.
past.description:
Our most successful study jam to date! Participants completed a structured 30-day program covering machine learning fundamentals, TensorFlow, and Google Cloud AI services.

Program highlights:
- Daily learning modules and assignments
- Weekly live Q&A sessions
- Hands-on projects with real datasets
- Google Cloud Skills Boost completion
- Final project presentations

45 students completed the program and earned their certificates!

speakers.name: Dr. Aisha Khan
speakers.title: ML Research Scientist
speakers.bio: Dr. Khan has published 15+ papers on deep learning and teaches ML at the university.

past.lessonsLearned: The hybrid format worked exceptionally well! Weekly in-person sessions helped maintain engagement. Key success factor: building a supportive community through Discord where participants helped each other. We'll definitely repeat this format for future study jams.
